summary.text: Chris Warwick is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 128 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A master electrician and business owner, he served as mayor of Bolivar, Missouri, from 2017 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Warwick, listed on Ballotpedia as Christopher Warwick, was born in Alton, Illinois, and graduated from Bolivar High School in 1996.
His career experience includes working as a master electrician and business owner.
He served as an alderman for Bolivar, Missouri, from 2012 to 2017 and as mayor from 2017 to 2024.
Warwick took office in the Missouri House on January 8, 2025, and for the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Budget Committee.
